responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for LM32 target options declared in lm32.opt. Each entry associates an option keyword such as mdivide-enabled, mbarrel-shift-enabled, msign-extend-enabled, or muser-enabled with the corresponding anchor in the generated GCC manual, allowing GCC’s option-help and diagnostic/documentation machinery to point from backend-defined -m options to the correct LM32-Options.html section. It is a generated metadata companion to the option-definition file rather than a source of target semantics or code-generation logic.
